method: Each application's backend and built frontend, served by scripts/runtime/serve_snapshot.py. Cold start: 5 process starts, each on an empty temporary workspace, so each includes the application's own first-run setup. Page load: Chromium, dark colour scheme, every addressable route at 390 and 1280 CSS pixels, 3 runs per cell, a fresh browser context per run. Medians are reported with minimum, maximum and relative spread (max minus min, over median).
limits: Measured in a Linux container over loopback. The numbers compare applications and commits with each other. They are not device timings and say nothing about macOS startup.
Fresh workspaces hold little data, so data-heavy pages load faster here than in real use.
Every cold-start run is on an empty workspace, so each includes the application's first-run setup. A start on an existing workspace was not measured.

first_run is one observation per tree, not a distribution. For a tree that had never been run it includes compiling Python bytecode and reading files for the first time; tree_previously_run says which trees that applies to.
A timing whose runs differ by more than 50% of the median is listed as unreliable for that cell.
No performance budget has been agreed. Nothing here is a pass or a failure.
